22098-the-seventh-day-sabbath-a-perpetua.creator: Unknown
22098-the-seventh-day-sabbath-a-perpetua.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. prophets." Then it would be impossible for the Sabbath to be left out. A question was asked, what shall I do to inherit eternal life? Says Jesus, "If thou wilt enter into life keep the commandments"--xix. Here he quotes five from the tables of stone.

arxiv-2011-00772.title: Some extended hypergeometric matrix functions and their fractional calculus
arxiv-2011-00772.creator: Ashish Verma, Ravi Dwivedi, Vivek Sahai
arxiv-2011-00772.description: Abstract In this paper, we study some extended hypergeometric functions from matrix point of view. We have given the integral representations of these matrix functions. Finally, we obtain some generating function relations using fractional derivative operators. Keywords : Matrix functional calculus, Appell functions, Lauricella functions, Fractional derivative operators AMS Subject Classification : 15A15; 33C65.

arxiv-2106-15263.title: Achieved Throughput of Hovering UAV-Based Optical Wireless Communications
arxiv-2106-15263.creator: Mohammad Taghi Dabiri, Seyed Mohammad Sajad Sadough and Himan Savojbolaghchi
arxiv-2106-15263.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Mohammad Taghi Dabiri, Seyed Mohammad Sajad Sadough and Himan Savojbolaghchi. Recently, free-space optical (FSO) communication systems have obtained a wide range of applications for communications between unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) because they offer several advantages with respect to the traditional RF communication systems. To investigate the performance of UAV-based FSO systems in terms of achievable data rates, we derive the exact closed-form expression for the mean achievable rates of UAV-to-UAV transmission.

arxiv-2211-05078.title: On the effect of localized and delocalized quasiparticles on a nonlinear conductivity of superconductors
arxiv-2211-05078.creator: A. Gurevich
arxiv-2211-05078.description: Abstract Recently Deyo et al. [Phys. Rev. B 106 , 104502 (2022)] suggested that the surface resistance R s ​ ( H 0 ) R_{s}(H_{0}) of a superconductor under strong electromagnetic field can be affected by field-induced quasiparticle bound states at the surface.

arxiv-2303-01041.title: D-Score: An Expert-Based Method for Assessing the Detectability of IoT-Related Cyber-Attacks
arxiv-2303-01041.creator: Yair Meidan, Daniel Benatar, Ron Bitton, Dan Avraham, and Asaf Shabtai
arxiv-2303-01041.description: Abstract IoT devices are known to be vulnerable to various cyber-attacks, such as data exfiltration and the execution of flooding attacks as part of a DDoS attack. When it comes to detecting such attacks using network traffic analysis, it has been shown that some attack scenarios are not always equally easy to detect if they involve different IoT models.

arxiv-2306-01000.title: New Insights into the Lamb Shift: The Spectral Density of the Shift
arxiv-2306-01000.creator: G. Jordan Maclay
arxiv-2306-01000.description: Abstract In an atom, the interaction of a bound electron with the vacuum fluctuations of the electromagnetic field leads to complex shifts in the energy levels of the electron, with the real part of the shift corresponding to a shift in the energy level and the imaginary part to the width of the energy level.

arxiv-2311-16527.title: Reconstruction of symmteric teleparallel gravity with energy conditions
arxiv-2311-16527.creator: Irfan Mahmood, Hira Sohail, Allah Ditta, S. H. Shekh, Anil Kumar Yadav
arxiv-2311-16527.description: Abstract Abstract: This research investigates the impact of modified gravity on cosmic scales, focusing on f ⁡ ( Q ) f(Q) cosmology. By applying energy conditions, the study reconstructs various f ⁡ ( Q ) f(Q) models, considering an accelerating Universe, quintessence, and a cosmological constant Λ \Lambda .

arxiv-2404-19556.title: A logarithmic approximation of linearly ordered colourings Thanks: This work was supported by UKRI EP/X024431/1, by a Clarendon Fund Scholarship and by the Knut and Alice Wallenberg Foundation. For the purpose of Open Access, the authors have applied a CC BY public copyright licence to any Author Ac
arxiv-2404-19556.creator: Johan Håstad, Björn Martinsson, Tamio-Vesa Nakajima, Stanislav Živný
arxiv-2404-19556.description: Abstract A linearly ordered (LO) k k -colouring of a hypergraph assigns to each vertex a colour from the set { 0 , 1 , … , k − 1 } \{0,1,\ldots,k-1\} in such a way that each hyperedge has a unique maximum element.

arxiv-2502-12921.title: Q-STRUM Debate: Query-Driven Contrastive Summarization for Recommendation Comparison
arxiv-2502-12921.creator: George-Kirollos Saad, Scott Sanner
arxiv-2502-12921.description: Abstract Query-driven recommendation with unknown items poses a challenge for users to understand why certain items are appropriate for their needs. Query-driven Contrastive Summarization (QCS) is a methodology designed to address this issue by leveraging language-based item descriptions to clarify contrasts between them. However, existing state-of-the-art contrastive summarization methods such as STRUM-LLM fall short of this goal.

arxiv-2503-00013.title: Reduced order modeling of the unsteady pressure on turbine rotor blades using deep learning
arxiv-2503-00013.creator: Dominique J, Salesses L, Thomas J. F, Baert L, Benamara T, Mastrippolito F, Flament T
arxiv-2503-00013.description: Abstract In transonic turbine stages, complex interactions between trailing edge shocks from nozzle guide vanes and rotor blades generate unsteady wall pressure fields, affecting the rotor aerodynamic performance and structural integrity. While shock-related phenomena are prominent, unsteady pressure fluctuations can also arise in subsonic regimes, where wake interactions alone are sufficient to induce instationarities.

arxiv-2509-03894.title: Second-Generation Planet Formation in Post-AGB Discs: Testing the Role of Gravitational Instability
arxiv-2509-03894.creator: Ali Pourmand, Devika Kamath, Orsola De Marco, Mark Wardle
arxiv-2509-03894.description: Abstract Post-Asymptotic Giant Branch (post-AGB) binary stars are evolved systems that host circumbinary discs formed through mass loss during late-stage binary interaction. Their structural, morphological, kinematic, and chemical similarities to planet-forming discs have motivated the idea that these systems exhibit the characteristics of second-generation protoplanetary discs and may act as sites of “second-generation” planet formation.

arxiv-2511-19124.title: Uncertainty-Aware Deep Learning Framework for Remaining Useful Life Prediction in Turbofan Engines with Learned Aleatoric Uncertainty
arxiv-2511-19124.creator: Krishang Sharma
arxiv-2511-19124.description: Abstract Accurate Remaining Useful Life (RUL) prediction coupled with uncertainty quantification remains a critical challenge in aerospace prognostics. This research introduces a novel uncertainty-aware deep learning framework that learns aleatoric uncertainty directly through probabilistic modeling—an approach unexplored in existing CMAPSS-based literature.

arxiv-2511-20137.title: Ionospheric VLF Radio Reflection Analysis System
arxiv-2511-20137.creator: George Dan Chita
arxiv-2511-20137.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by George Dan Chita. Historically, solar flare detection has been dependent on methods that require the presence of expensive satellites or other Earth-based costly equipment. In this paper, we propose a cost-effective, terrestrial alternative that enables reliable solar flare detection. We will discuss the design, practical implementation, and demonstration of a monitoring system for VLF (Very Low Frequency, 3 kHz–30 kHz) radio signals transmitted by stations located thousands of kilometers away.

arxiv-2602-11912.title: Millisecond-Scale Calibration and Benchmarking of Superconducting Qubits
arxiv-2602-11912.creator: Malthe A. Marciniak, Rune T. Birke, Johann B. Severin, Fabrizio Berritta, Daniel Kjær, Filip Nilsson, Smitha N. Themadath, Sangeeth Kallatt, James L. Webb, Kristoffer Bentsen, Tonny Madsen, Zhenhai Sun, Svend Krøjer, Christopher W. Warren, Jacob Hastrup, Morten Kjaergaard
arxiv-2602-11912.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Malthe A. Marciniak, Rune T. Birke, Johann B. Severin, Fabrizio Berritta, Daniel Kjær, Filip Nilsson, Smitha N. Themadath, Sangeeth Kallatt, James L. Webb, Kristoffer Bentsen, Tonny Madsen, Zhenhai Sun, Svend Krøjer, Christopher W. Warren, Jacob Hastrup, Morten Kjaergaard. Superconducting qubit parameters drift on sub-second timescales, motivating calibration and benchmarking techniques that can be executed on millisecond timescales. We demonstrate an on-FPGA workflow that co-locates pulse generation, data acquisition, analysis, and feed-forward, eliminating CPU round trips.

pmc-10656986.title: Silver diamine fluoride with sodium fluoride varnish versus silver diamine fluoride in arresting early childhood caries: a 6-months follow up of a randomized field trial
pmc-10656986.creator: Enas B Abdellatif, Mona K El Kashlan, Maha El Tantawi
pmc-10656986.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundEarly childhood caries (ECC) is the most prevalent chronic health problem in young children, and it can be arrested using professionally applied fluoride such as Sodium fluoride (NaF) varnish and Silver Diamine Fluoride (SDF).

pmc-11499625.title: Attempted Removal of a Large Pheochromocytoma via a Robotic Approach
pmc-11499625.creator: Britiel Bethishou, Debora J Fox-McClary, Susan Wcislak
pmc-11499625.description: A pheochromocytoma is a rare tumor of neuroendocrine origin that secretes hormones like epinephrine, norepinephrine, and occasionally dopamine. The most notable symptom of the release of catecholamines is exceedingly high blood pressure. A 45-year-old male presented with a symptomatic pheochromocytoma of large size. He reported experiencing fatigue, orthopnea, dizziness, headache, and chest tightness with deep inspiration for several months.

pmc-11678983.title: The Influence of Polylactic Acid Filament Moisture Content on Dust Emissions in 3D Printing Process
pmc-11678983.creator: Anna Karwasz, Filip Osiński, Weronika Kaczmarek, Kacper Furmaniak, Izabela Rojek
pmc-11678983.description: This paper presents the results of a study on the effect of moisture content in polylactic acid (PLA) filaments on dust emissions during incremental manufacturing. The tests were conducted in a customised chamber using a standard 3D printer, and Plantower PMS3003 sensors were used to monitor air quality by measuring PM1, PM2.5 and PM10 concentrations.

pmc-12692975.title: Cross-Sectional Study of Bone Mineral Density in Chronic Stroke According to Walking Speed
pmc-12692975.creator: Maria-Arantzazu Ruescas-Nicolau, M Luz Sánchez-Sánchez, Mónica Ahulló, Carmen Ballester-Estevan, Marco Iosa, Georgios Tsivgoulis, Yuji Uchio
pmc-12692975.description: Background/Objectives: Bone mineral density (BMD) assessments are uncommon in people with chronic stroke, and the relationship between BMD and gait speed remains poorly understood. This study examined between-limb differences in BMD of individuals with chronic stroke and limited versus non-limited community ambulation and analyzed the relationship between BMD and gait speed.

pmc-12966252.title: Genome-wide characterization of soybean alcohol dehydrogenase (ADH) genes identifies GmADH13 as a positive regulator of the salt stress response
pmc-12966252.creator: Sihui Wang, Zhiyuan Xu, Peng Cheng, Jun Yang, Qiang Hao, Jinfang Wang, Ziqian Cheng, Lingshi Xia, Zhenbang Hu, Xin Li, Anyu Su
pmc-12966252.description: Alcohol dehydrogenase (ADH) is a zinc-binding enzyme responsible for catalyzing the interconversion between ethanol and acetaldehyde, as well as other alcohol and aldehyde pairs, within the ethanol fermentation pathway. This enzyme plays a crucial role in plant adaptation to environmental stressors. However, knowledge regarding the ADH gene family in soybean remains limited.

pmc-13548288.title: Australian Paediatric Acute Code Stroke study: study protocol for a quasi-experimental trial measuring the impact of Code Stroke protocols on time to diagnosis and access to reperfusion therapies
pmc-13548288.creator: Mark T Mackay, Belinda Stojanovski, Nicola Fearn, Michael Fahey, Ian Andrews, Christopher Troedson, Richard Webster, Christina Miteff, Adriane Sinclair, Claire Pridmore, Snehal Shah, Claire G Spooner, Leonid Churilov, Bruce C V Campbell, Lan Gao, Dominique Cadilhac, Franz E Babl, Dee Banks, Lisa Mur
pmc-13548288.description: IntroductionChildhood stroke leads to long-term neurological impairment, impacts on quality of life and has substantial economic costs. Coordinated systems of care are required to streamline rapid diagnosis and treatment of stroke. The primary aim is to investigate the effect of Code Stroke protocols on increasing the proportion of children with stroke diagnosed within the 4.5-hour time window for reperfusion therapies.

pmc-13561245.title: Intra-abdominal Versus Descending Thoracic Cannulation Techniques for Abdominal Normothermic Regional Perfusion
pmc-13561245.creator: Grace Boyne, Olivia Claire Walker, Jinyu Du, Johanna Bayer, Juan Sebastian Danobeitia, Geoffrey Funk, Amar Gupta, Seung-Hee Lee, Eric Martinez, Kara Monday, Scott Noesges, Murphy Rayle, Giuliano Testa, Anji Wall
pmc-13561245.description: Background.Abdominal normothermic regional perfusion (A-NRP) is postmortem perfusion of organs in the abdominal cavity and can be performed using multiple approaches, including femoral, intra-abdominal, and thoracic. Our program began with surgeons performing intra-abdominal cannulations with mechanical or balloon occlusion of the descending thoracic aorta for A-NRP procedures.

pmc-13630664.title: Case Report: Multisystem response to dupilumab in a child with atopic dermatitis, asthma, eosinophilic esophagitis, and other gastrointestinal manifestations
pmc-13630664.creator: Hua-Jie Yan, Wei Dong, Yu-Nan Yang, Chun-Yun Zeng
pmc-13630664.description: BackgroundAtopic dermatitis (AD), asthma, and eosinophilic esophagitis (EoE) may coexist because they share type 2 inflammatory pathways. Evidence for dupilumab in children with EoE and other gastrointestinal manifestations remains limited.Case presentationA 7-year-old girl had poorly controlled AD, recurrent asthma, EoE (>100 eosinophils/high-power field), and lower-density eosinophilic infiltration in gastric, ileal, and colonic biopsies.
